notes.drawing: Direction A: a plate (x 24 to 232, y 64 to 192, corner radius 8, credit-card's width) with the band on the left as on European plates, left empty: no country code. The characters are 12, drawn as Phosphor's number-one and number-two at the size of its file-type letters (56 high, round ends, 18 units apart at the narrowest), centred between the band and the right edge. Three characters (123) were tried: at 16 px they ran into each other and into the band.
notes.fill: Solid, with the band line and the characters cut out in white; the band becomes a separate strip, as the blue strip is on a real plate.
notes.duotone: Only the band is tinted, where a real plate has its blue strip.
